items.contact: Scott Gilman, Health, Housing, and Community Services, (510) 981-5100
items.action: Action: M/S/C (Lunaparra/Tregub) to adopt Resolution No. 72,418–N.S. amending the Inclusionary Housing in-lieu fee to establish a 2,500 square foot Residential Unit Floor Area (RUFA) deduction for all detached single-family residential units and maintain the 5,000 square foot RUFA deduction for multi-unit residential projects. Vote: All Ayes.

items.heading: Referral to Schedule Hopkins Street for Paving with Enhanced Safety Improvements for all Users (Reviewed by the Facilities, Infrastructure, Transportation, Environment & Sustainability Committee)
items.from: Councilmember Kesarwani (Author), Councilmember Humbert (Co- Sponsor), Mayor Ishii (Co-Sponsor)
items.action: Action: M/S/C (Ishii/Tregub) to suspend the rules and implement a three-hour public comment period for Item 27. Vote: All Ayes. Action: M/S/C (Tregub/Taplin) to suspend the rules and extend the council meeting to 12:30 a.m. Vote: Ayes – Taplin, Bartlett, Tregub, O’Keefe, Blackaby, Lunaparra, Humbert, Ishii; Noes – None; Abstain – None; Absent – Kesarwani. Action: M/S/C (Humbert/Taplin) to suspend the rules and extend the council meeting to 1:00 a.m. Vote: All Ayes. Action: M/S/Failed (O’Keefe/Blackaby) to adopt the supplemental item from Councilmember O’Keefe with the language regarding street trees assessments from Councilmember Kesarwani’s item and to remove the word “buffered” from the edits. Vote: Ayes – Bartlett, O’Keefe, Blackaby; Noes – Kesarwani, Taplin, Tregub, Lunaparra, Humbert, Ishii. Council Action Items Action: M/S/Failed (Blackaby/O’Keefe) to approve the supplemental item from Councilmember Blackaby with additional amendments to analyze parking impacts, a timeline for the analysis and paving work, metrics to consider bike lanes, and when to consider sharrows. Vote: Ayes – Bartlett, Tregub, O’Keefe, Blackaby; Noes – Kesarwani, Taplin, Lunaparra, Humbert, Ishii. Action: 160 speakers. M/S/Carried (Kesarwani/Humbert) to approve the recommendation as submitted by Councilmember Kesarwani and further amended at the meeting regarding street trees assessments, consideration of placemaking elements, and clarification that this referral supersedes all prior referrals regarding Hopkins Street improvements. Vote: Ayes – Kesarwani, Taplin, Bartlett, Tregub, Lunaparra, Humbert, Ishii; Noes – O’Keefe, Blackaby.
